<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Nosso Pequeno Universo</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@500;600&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');

:root{
  --bg:#0d0709; --bg2:#1a0b10; --card:#241017; --purple:#8f2438;
  --purple2:#d89aa7; --text:#f7f1ff; --muted:#c0aeb3;
  --border:rgba(196,165,255,.18);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  margin:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%,#3a111d 0,#0d0709 42%);
  color:var(--text);font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;min-height:100vh;
}
body:before{
  content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.22;
  background-image:radial-gradient(#d89aa7 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:70px 70px;
}
button,input,textarea{font:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer}
.hidden{display:none!important}
.center{min-height:100vh;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:24px}
.hero{text-align:center;max-width:760px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.moon{font-size:42px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px #a66cff);margin-bottom:18px}
h1{font-family:"Cormorant Garamond",serif;font-size:clamp(48px,9vw,86px);line-height:.9;margin:0 0 22px}
.hero p{font-size:18px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7;margin:0 auto 34px;max-width:600px}
.primary{
  border:1px solid rgba(196,165,255,.35);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#8f2438,#6f1c2d);
  color:white;padding:15px 25px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;
  box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(155,108,255,.25);transition:.3s;
}
.primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 0 42px rgba(155,108,255,.42)}
nav{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  background:rgba(11,7,17,.75);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.navin{max-width:1100px;margin:auto;padding:14px 20px;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;overflow:auto}
.logo{font-family:"Cormorant Garamond";font-size:25px;margin-right:auto;white-space:nowrap}
.navin button{background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--muted);padding:9px 12px;border-radius:9px;white-space:nowrap}
.navin button:hover{color:white;background:rgba(155,108,255,.1)}
main{max-width:1100px;margin:auto;padding:45px 20px 90px}
section{margin-bottom:80px;scroll-margin-top:90px}
.eyebrow{color:var(--purple2);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:3px;font-size:12px}
.title{font-family:"Cormorant Garamond";font-size:48px;margin:8px 0 12px}
.sub{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7}
.card{
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(31,19,45,.9),rgba(18,11,29,.9));
  border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:22px;padding:24px;
  box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
}
.story{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:25px;align-items:stretch}
.cover{
  min-height:440px;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2b1741,#0f0917);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#a89499;
}
.cover img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;position:absolute;inset:0}
.cover span{position:relative;z-index:1}
.names{font-family:"Cormorant Garamond";font-size:48px;margin:0}
.date{color:var(--purple2);margin:7px 0 22px}
.counter{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:10px}
.time{background:rgba(155,108,255,.08);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:14px 8px;text-align:center;border-radius:14px}
.time b{font-size:23px;display:block}.time small{color:var(--muted)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}
.memory{overflow:hidden;padding:0}.memory img{width:100%;height:220px;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.memory .body{padding:17px}
.memory h3{margin:0 0 7px}.memory p{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}
.timeline{position:relative;margin-left:12px;padding-left:28px;border-left:1px solid #7a3444}
.event{position:relative;margin:0 0 30px}.event:before{
 content:"";position:absolute;left:-34px;top:5px;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;
 background:var(--purple2);box-shadow:0 0 16px var(--purple)
}
.event time{font-size:12px;color:var(--purple2)} .event h3{margin:6px 0}
.envelope-wrap{display:grid;place-items:center;padding:30px}
.envelope{
 width:min(420px,90vw);height:250px;border-radius:16px;position:relative;
 background:linear-gradient(135deg,#632536,#32131c);border:1px solid #9a6fc1;
 box-shadow:0 25px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.35);transition:.7s;
}
.envelope:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,transparent 49%,rgba(255,255,255,.12) 50%,transparent 51%)}
.seal{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:55px;height:55px;border-radius:50%;background:#d19aaa;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#3a121c;font-size:22px;z-index:2}
.letter{display:none;max-width:720px;margin:25px auto 0;background:#f2e5e7;color:#29151a;padding:38px;border-radius:5px;box-shadow:0 20px 70px #0008;font-family:"Cormorant Garamond",serif;font-size:21px;line-height:1.7}
.envelope.open{transform:translateY(-20px) rotateX(65deg);opacity:.35}
.envelope.open + .letter{display:block;animation:appear .8s}
@keyframes appear{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.music{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px}.disc{width:70px;height:70px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#d8a6b0 0 8%,#713040 9% 25%,#1a0a0e 26%);animation:spin 5s linear infinite paused}
.disc.play{animation-play-state:running}@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.msggrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:15px}
.msg{min-height:150px;perspective:800px}.msg button{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:150px;background:transparent;border:0;padding:0;color:white}
.msginner{height:100%;min-height:150px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:22px;background:#201016;transition:.5s}
.msg.revealed .msginner{background:#2d151d}.msg p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6}
.admin{margin-top:30px}.admin-panel{display:none;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.admin-panel.show{display:flex!important}
input,textarea{background:#100a17;color:white;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:11px;outline:none}
textarea{width:100%;min-height:100px}.field{flex:1;min-width:200px}
footer{text-align:center;color:#806e73;padding:30px}
#lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#000d;display:none;place-items:center;z-index:50;padding:25px}
#lightbox.show{display:grid}#lightbox img{max-width:95vw;max-height:90vh;border-radius:12px}
@media(max-width:800px){.story{grid-template-columns:1fr}.grid,.msggrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.counter{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:520px){.grid,.msggrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.cover{min-height:320px}.title{font-size:40px}.counter{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}

.editor-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding-bottom:15px}
.editor-tabs button,.secondary{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid var(--border);color:#eadde1;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:10px}
.editor-tabs button:hover,.secondary:hover{background:rgba(143,36,56,.2)}
.editor-page{animation:appear .3s}
.editor-page h3{font-family:"Cormorant Garamond";font-size:28px;margin-top:0}
.editor-page input,.editor-page textarea{display:block;width:100%;margin:10px 0}
.upload{display:block;border:1px dashed #8f5060;border-radius:12px;padding:18px;text-align:center;margin:12px 0;color:#d8aeb7;cursor:pointer}
.upload input{display:none!important}
.editor-actions,.danger-zone{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:15px}
.edit-item{border:1px solid var(--border);padding:14px;border-radius:14px;margin:10px 0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.edit-item textarea,.edit-item input{margin:6px 0!important}
.danger-zone{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding-top:20px;margin-top:30px}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="lock" class="center">
  <div class="hero">
    <div class="moon">♥</div>
    <div class="eyebrow">um lugar só nosso</div>
    <h1>Nosso pequeno universo</h1>
    <p>Um pequeno lugar na internet que guarda um pouco de nós dois.</p>
    <button class="primary" onclick="enterSite()">ABRIR NOSSA HISTÓRIA</button>
    <p style="font-size:12px;margin-top:18px">Este espaço é protegido por um código secreto.</p>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="app" class="hidden">
<nav><div class="navin">
  <div class="logo">♡ Nós dois</div>
  <button onclick="go('historia')">História</button><button onclick="go('galeria')">Memórias</button>
  <button onclick="go('timeline')">Linha do tempo</button><button onclick="go('carta')">Carta</button>
  <button onclick="go('musica')">Música</button><button onclick="go('mensagens')">Mensagens</button>
</div></nav>

<main>
<section id="historia">
  <div class="eyebrow">nossa história</div><h2 class="title">Onde tudo começou</h2>
  <div class="story">
    <div class="cover" id="cover"><span>Adicione aqui a foto principal ♡</span></div>
    <div class="card">
      <h3 class="names" id="names">Nome & Nome</h3>
      <div class="date" id="startDate">09/09/2025</div>
      <div class="counter" id="counter"></div>
      <p class="sub" id="storyText">Aqui você pode escrever um pedacinho da história de vocês. Como se conheceram, o que fez vocês se aproximarem e os pequenos detalhes que tornaram tudo especial.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="galeria">
  <div class="eyebrow">lembranças guardadas</div><h2 class="title">Galeria de memórias</h2>
  <p class="sub">Cada foto pode virar uma pequena cápsula do tempo.</p>
  <div class="grid" id="gallery"></div>
</section>

<section id="timeline">
  <div class="eyebrow">capítulos</div><h2 class="title">Linha do tempo</h2>
  <div class="timeline" id="timelineList"></div>
</section>

<section id="carta">
  <div class="eyebrow">para você</div><h2 class="title">Uma carta especial</h2>
  <div class="envelope-wrap">
    <div class="envelope" id="envelope" onclick="openLetter()"><div class="seal">♡</div></div>
    <div class="letter" id="letter">
      <h2>Para nós</h2>
      <p id="letterText">Escreva aqui a carta que você quer deixar guardada neste pequeno universo.</p>
      <p style="text-align:right">Com carinho, ♡</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="musica">
  <div class="eyebrow">nossa trilha sonora</div><h2 class="title">A nossa música</h2>
  <div class="card music">
    <div class="disc" id="disc"></div>
    <div><h3 id="songName">Nossa música especial</h3><p class="sub">A música só começa quando vocês apertarem play.</p></div>
    <button class="primary" onclick="toggleMusic()" id="musicBtn">▶ Tocar</button>
    <audio id="audio" preload="none" src="data:audio/mpeg;base64,... (5 MB restante(s))
